experiment_data.hypothesis: Qwen2.5-14B constrained vs uniform pipeline. Verify Spike prediction: concentration=0.33, t1/t5=24.35 → MCKP ≈ uniform (no benefit from non-uniform allocation). Compare uniform 4-bit, constrained MCKP, and unconstrained MCKP PPL on WikiText-2.

spec.description: Constrained pipeline: uniform 4-bit vs constrained MCKP (k=8) vs unconstrained MCKP. Tests Spike prediction (conc=0.33, t1/t5=24.35): MCKP ~ uniform.

experiment_data.notes: Running on cuda:1 (PID 329678). Solver results: constrained k=8 → {4:374, 8:1, 16:1, 2:8}, unconstrained → {4:271, 2:77, 8:35, 16:1}. Baseline eval in progress ~300/583 chunks. ETA ~20-30min for all 4 evals (baseline + uniform + constrained + unconstrained).
